title: How to make party member through or make it so other events stop colliding with party member

posts.author: knuckles_the_chuckles
posts.body:
So for my game I'm working on a level that have a character follow you around.
I also set up these little traps on the level. For this level what the traps do is simply push the player back. For example theres this little skeleton animatronic that walks back and forward and if he collides with the player it causes the player to stumble backwards.
What I'm finding however is that if the skeleton collides with the player and he stumbles backwards, my follower then gets in front of the player and begins blocking the skeleton, creating a barrier between him and the player.
So my idea was trying to either find a way to make events pass through the follower or make the follower through so the traps stop colliding with him.
Is there any way of doing this?
Thank you

posts.author: Timtrack
posts.body:
Hello, I recall a similar question
here
.
If you just want to disable collision with followers, you can put this scriptlet:
Ruby:
class Game_Followers
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # overwrite method: collide?
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def collide?(x, y)
    false
  end
end #Game_Followers
That way your events will be able to reach the player.
